commits.message:
fix: correct middleware execution order for password change enforcement (#4742)

Fixes #4736

This change hardens the login process by ensuring the password change
enforcement middleware executes after authentication context is established.

Changes:
- Swapped middleware registration order in main.py (lines 3091-3134)
- PasswordChangeEnforcementMiddleware now added first (runs second)
- AuthContextMiddleware now added second (runs first)
- Added comprehensive security edge case tests (18 new tests)
- All 30 tests passing (18 new + 12 existing)

The middleware execution order is critical because Starlette/FastAPI
processes middleware in reverse order of addition. This ensures
request.state.user is populated before password enforcement checks.

Test coverage includes:
- All HTTP methods enforcement
- Missing/None attribute handling
- Path traversal prevention
- Auth method variations
- State isolation between requests
- Feature flag integrity

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Brian Hussey <brian.hussey@ie.ibm.com>
